subject: th-cont
title: TH.CONT.-----PER.TRS.
description: First of two diagrams in R(AS)CM(I)-2, the opening section of 'Reality Aspect of Creative Music — Level One.' The prose above identifies the mechanism Braxton is structurally diagramming: 'the nature of the journalism that took place in the early period of bebop transcended the particulars of a given focus (or opinion), but instead moved to suppress the reality position (and/or affinity dynamics) underlying what a given creative participation really meant (in its vibrational and cosmic sense).' The crossing names how that suppression worked structurally: TH-CONT (thrust continuance — the form's actual forward motion) is crossed with PER-TRS (perceived transition — what the journalism declared the bebop transition to be). TH-CONT sits on the left with the subject-arrow; STR descends from the main line, and ALT-F (alternative functionalism) branches from STR. PER-TRS is partner-center and carries no branches. APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) sits just below PER-TRS but branches from the ALT-F line; (R)EXT-F (the reality of extended functionalism) runs right from APP-RDEF, AF-TF (affinity transfer) rises from the EXT-F line and AF-TD branches up-right from AF-TF, and (P)ASP-ES (aspect essence at its point of idea completion) hangs from the EXT-F line at the lower-right margin, with AFL (affinity alignment) branching from (P)ASP-ES at the bottom. Structural argument: when thrust-continuance is crossed with the journalism's perceived-transition narrative, the subject's own chain (STR → ALT-F → APP-RDEF) carries everything on the right — (R)EXT-F, AF-TF, AF-TD, (P)ASP-ES, AFL — so the form's extended-functionalism is reached only after passing through APP-RDEF, where applied redefinitions intercept it. That interception is exactly Braxton's 'cross-transfer definitions' mechanism.
